text:
jia: Quick sync — saw two billing regressions in the v2 canary related to header fallbacks. Need owners + next steps. Summary: when client omits X-Billing-Id, proxy fallback path sometimes drops the header before upstream, producing 402 from billing.
matt: ack. do we know if this is SDK->proxy or proxy->upstream? which side should we patch first?
eric: looks like proxy->upstream. I traced logs: proxy receives x-billing-id but after our header-normalizer middleware it becomes `x-billing` and the billing service only looks for `x-billing-id`.
sarah: oof. regression introduced in the normalizer refactor (PR #4201). QA hit it in EU-canary when traffic was routed to new proxy image.
jia: here's the quick repro from the canary logs:
```
PROXY REQ: { headers: { 'X-Client-Version': '2.0.0', 'x-billing-id': 'acct-1234' }}
NORMALIZER OUT: { headers: { 'x-client-version': '2.0.0', 'x-billing': 'acct-1234' }}
UPSTREAM REQ: { headers: { 'x-client-version': '2.0.0' }}  # billing missing -> 402
```
matt: thanks. SDK can also be more defensive — we can add a `X-Billing-Id` explicit header for v2 clients in the next patch. I can own the SDK change and the release if teams agree.
eric: infra fix is small: keep normalized names but add a mapping alias to preserve `x-billing-id` header when present. I can put up a PR to proxy today.
sarah: QA will add regression tests for header aliasing and run the canary smoke once infra PR is up. ETA for tests: EOD.
jia: ownership proposals: infra (eric) -> proxy alias PR, SDK (matt) -> explicit header fallback in SDK, QA (sarah) -> regression tests + canary smoke. I'll add to rollout tracker and pause EU canary until infra PR lands.
matt: I'll draft SDK patch and link PR here — will aim for a minor bump and add feature flag `force-billing-header-v2`.

matt: PR draft: https://git.redd/infer/sdk/pulls/1287 (WIP) — needs a quick review from @eric for header name assumptions.
eric: i'll review, but priority is the proxy PR first so we can unpause canary. creating PR now.
deploy-bot: Canary pause requested by jia. Canaries in EU region suspended at 2024-05-15T14:20Z :pause_button:
billing-bot: Alert: observed 37 billing 402s from EU canary since 14:00Z, rate stable but elevated.
sarah: QA note — add a unit test to ensure normalization preserves aliases: assert header('x-billing-id') || header('x-billing') -> upstream gets x-billing-id.
jia: Action items (short):
- eric: proxy alias PR (blocker) — assign and notify infra oncall
- matt: SDK patch + feature flag PR — prepare for minor release
- sarah: regression tests + canary smoke once proxy PR merged
- jia: update rollout tracker, pause/unpause canary, owner handoff

Can we confirm owners here so I can mark them in the tracker? @eric, @matt, @sarah?
